messages:

Subject: Post-demo: unit-cost scenarios and pilot invoice sketch

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning, Tom — great conversation. As promised, attached is a simple model that lays out a couple of realistic unit-econ scenarios for the pilot. Quick recap and asks:

- What monthly token range should we model for the pilot window (est. 1–3 months)? Rough buckets are fine (e.g., 50–150M / 150–500M / 500M+).
- Do you have a target spend or target $/1M tokens that Procurement will want us to hit? If so, call it out.
- Any constraints on retention/utterance length we should bake in (avg tokens per call)?

Attached: aurelia_token_model.xlsx — 3 sheets (Assumptions, Scenario outputs, Line-item invoice sketch). The model assumes continuous batching with KV cache for short conversational flows (avg tokens = 1,200). If you prefer we can re-run with a lower avg tokens to show sensitivity.

Next steps proposed:
1) You send a target token/budget range (reply-stub below)
2) We return a provisional invoice + one-page PO-ready summary for your procurement team within 48 hours
3) Quick follow-up call to review procurement checklist (15–20m)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: aurelia_token_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-cost scenarios and pilot invoice sketch

Jordan — thanks, and the model looks helpful at first glance. A few quick data points from our side to help you tune:

- Pilot duration: 2 months (Aug–Sep)
- Expected monthly volume: 120M–200M tokens (we’re conservative for month 1, ramp in month 2)
- Avg tokens per request: ~900 (short conversations + metadata)
- Procurement target: budget around $6k–$10k/month for the pilot (our VP wants to see cost ~<$8k/mo if possible)

If you can show a scenario that lands at or under $8k/month for 150M tokens (with conservative latency SLOs), that will get us past the initial gating. Also include any one-time setup or minimum commit requirements in the invoice.

—Tom
Tom Nguyen
Head of AI Product, Aurelia Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurelia-systems.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-cost scenarios and pilot invoice sketch

Tom — great context, thanks. I ran the attached model against your 150M token target and a few assumptions below; summarized results follow. I left the workbook with three scenarios (Conservative / Target / Aggressive). Key assumptions I used for the Target scenario (attached sheet named 'Scenario_Target'):

- Model mix: 60% base OpenDecoder-XL (cost tier mid), 40% Redwood-Opt-8 (lower-cost quantized)
- Avg tokens per request: 900 (your number)
- Effective batching + cache reduction: 22% token-cost reduction (we assume persistent KV for repeated user sessions)
- Infra and throughput: Dedicated small pod equivalent, no extra priority burst

Target scenario (150M tokens / month):
- Nominal compute & infra cost (internal): $3,200
- Platform & runtime surcharge (Redwood): $1,100
- Data egress & storage: $120
- Taxes & misc: $80
- Total monthly invoice estimate: $4,500
- Effective rate per 1M tokens: $30

Conservative (lower batching, higher avg tokens): $6,800 total ($45 / 1M)
Aggressive (max batching, lower-cost mix): $3,000 total ($20 / 1M)

Notes:
- The model shows sensitivity primarily to avg tokens and model mix. If you can push more queries to Redwood-Opt-8 or improve caching, the effective $/1M drops quickly.
- No one-time onboarding fee included here. If Procurement requires a PO we can add a line for a one-time account setup ($1,200) or fold into month 1.

I'll also attach a one-page invoice sketch in PDF format if you want a PO-ready artifact. Jordan / Karthik — happy to jump on a 20m call tomorrow for procurement prep.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurelia_token_model.xlsx (updated with 'Scenario_Target' sheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurelia-systems.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-cost scenarios and pilot invoice sketch

Tom — appreciate the clarity on budget. Based on Marissa's Target scenario I drafted a provisional invoice and a simple pilot statement-of-work (attached as provisional_invoice_8921.pdf). Highlights:

- Pilot term: 2 months
- Monthly charge (month 1): $4,700 (conservative buffer + 10% platform contingency)
- Monthly charge (month 2): $4,500 (anticipated steady-state)
- One-time setup (optional): $1,200
- Total estimated spend (pilot): $10,400–$10,600 depending on whether setup fee is included

Next steps I recommend we take this week:
1) Procurement call — 30 minutes to confirm PO fields and signatory (we can host)
2) Provide PO template to procurement@aurelia-systems.com (we'll map fields)
3) Kick pilot on receipt of PO + SOW signature

If that aligns, Jordan and I will calendar the procurement call — availability windows below: Wed 08/04 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 08/05 13:00–15:00 PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional_invoice_8921.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
